displayName: OCI-AI-GOV-015: AI — High-Risk System Without Assessment
description:
Detects high-risk AI systems operating without mandatory risk assessments

⚠️ NEEDS-REWRITE: Query is generic SQL, needs conversion to Cloud Guard detector condition

dataSourceDetails.query: SELECT "siem_general_ai_gov_015", "data__json.rEventName" FROM "oci_monitoring_metricexplorer_metrics" WHERE "compartmentId" = '$COMPARTMENT_ID' AND "namespace" = 'AuditEvents' AND "data__json.rEventName" LIKE '%high%' AND "value" > 0
